basket.discount_too_large.explanation:
Sale screen basket: shown under a line's discount box when the cashier enters a discount (or lowers the quantity) so the discount would be more than the line's total. The change is not applied.

Placeholders:
- %s: the line's total, the most the discount can be (an amount of money with currency)

basket.line_changed.explanation: Sale screen basket: shown under a line (or above the totals when the line no longer exists) when the cashier's quantity or discount change was not applied because the same line changed (or was removed) in the meantime, for example from another screen or a quick second tap. Nothing was charged or recorded by this edit.

basket.tile_in_basket.explanation:
Phone sale screen: screen-reader text added to an item tile's name when that item is in the current sale, e.g. "Latte, 2 in basket". Not shown visually (the tile shows only a number badge). The string starts with a comma and a space as a separator, because it is read right after the price ("Latte £2.50, 2 in basket"); keep a leading separator in translations. Write the number as %d exactly (the till replaces only a literal %d); the string has one form for every count.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many of this item are in the current sale

card_reader.announce.changed.explanation:
Announced to screen readers when a card reader's state changes while the picker is open. First placeholder is the reader's name, second its new state (Ready, Busy, Offline).

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the card reader
- %s: new state of the reader

card_reader.busy.explanation: Shown when the chosen card reader turned out to be in use; no payment was taken.

card_reader.invalid.explanation: Shown when the chosen card reader is no longer set up on this till; no payment was taken.

card_reader.kind.bluetooth.explanation: Kind label of a card reader connected by Bluetooth.

card_reader.kind.cloud.explanation: Kind label of a card terminal reached over the internet through its payment provider.

card_reader.kind.phone.explanation: Kind label of a phone or tablet paired as a card reader.

card_reader.kind.tap_to_pay.explanation: Kind label of the entry that takes contactless payments on this phone or tablet itself.

card_reader.kiosk_none.explanation: Shown to a customer on the self-order screen when no card reader is set up for self-service. Plain words, no technical terms.

card_reader.needs_plugin_update.explanation:
Shown next to a card reader whose payment plugin is too old to work with several readers. The placeholder is the plugin's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the payment plugin

card_reader.none_ready.explanation: Shown in the reader picker when every card reader is busy, offline or needs setup.

card_reader.pick.auto.explanation:
Announced to screen readers when the only ready card reader is used without asking. The placeholder is the reader's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the card reader

card_reader.pick.back.explanation: Button in the reader picker that goes back to the list of payment methods without paying.

card_reader.pick.checking.explanation: Shown with a spinner while the till asks the card readers whether they are ready; takes at most a few seconds.

card_reader.pick.confirm.explanation:
Button that starts the card payment once a reader is chosen. First placeholder is the amount to pay with its currency symbol, second is the reader's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: amount to pay, with currency symbol
- %s: name of the chosen card reader

card_reader.pick.default_tag.explanation: Small tag on the reader that took the previous card payment on this till; it is chosen by default.

card_reader.pinned.explanation: Shown in the reader picker when a card payment was started and its result is unknown: it can only be retried on the same reader.

card_reader.reason.unknown.explanation: One line under a card reader whose readiness could not be checked; it can still be chosen.

card_reader.settings.add.explanation: Button that adds a card reader to this till.

card_reader.settings.count.explanation:
Line on the card readers page showing how many readers are set up out of the most this till allows. Both placeholders are whole numbers.

Placeholders:
- %d: readers set up
- %d: most readers allowed

card_reader.settings.empty.explanation: Shown on the card readers page when the list is empty.

card_reader.settings.err_in_use.explanation: Error on the card readers settings page when a manager tries to remove a reader while a card payment is running on it or is waiting to be retried on it.

card_reader.settings.err_name.explanation: Error when the reader name is empty, too long or already used.

card_reader.settings.err_ref.explanation: Error when the reader ID has characters that are not allowed, the provider does not support it, or it is already added.

card_reader.settings.help.explanation: Introduction on the card readers page for managers.

card_reader.settings.limit_reached.explanation:
Shown when the till already has the most card readers it allows. The placeholder is that number.

Placeholders:
- %d: most readers allowed

card_reader.settings.move_down.explanation: Button that moves a card reader one place down in the list shown to cashiers.

card_reader.settings.move_up.explanation: Button that moves a card reader one place up in the list shown to cashiers.

card_reader.settings.name.explanation: Label of the field for the name staff see when choosing a card reader.

card_reader.settings.name_help.explanation: Help text under the reader name field.

card_reader.settings.no_providers.explanation: Shown instead of the add form when no installed payment plugin can work with several readers.

card_reader.settings.provider.explanation: Label of the field for choosing which payment provider the card reader belongs to.

card_reader.settings.reader_id.explanation: Label of the field for the card reader's identifier as the payment provider knows it.

card_reader.settings.reader_id_help.explanation: Help text under the reader ID field. The characters listed are the only ones allowed.

card_reader.settings.remove.explanation: Button, and the confirm button of its question, that removes a card reader from this till.

card_reader.settings.remove_confirm.explanation:
Question before removing a card reader. The placeholder is the reader's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the card reader

card_reader.settings.remove_confirm_lega.explanation:
Question before removing a card reader that is also saved in its payment plugin's own settings. First placeholder is the reader's name, second the plugin's name.

Placeholders:
- %s: name of the card reader
- %s: name of the payment plugin

card_reader.settings.rename.explanation: Button that renames a card reader.

card_reader.settings.saved.explanation: Confirmation after a card reader change was saved.

card_reader.settings.source_migrated.explanation: Small tag on a card reader that was taken over automatically from the payment plugin's own reader setting.

card_reader.settings.title.explanation: Title of the page where a manager sets up the card readers of this till, and the name of the link to it in Settings.

card_reader.settings.unattended_default.explanation: Checkbox label: this card reader is the one the self-order kiosk uses. Only one reader can have it.

card_reader.settings.unattended_tag.explanation: Small tag on the card reader that the self-order kiosk uses.

card_reader.split.choose.explanation: First option of the reader field in the split payment form, before a reader is chosen.

card_reader.split.label.explanation: Label of the field in the split payment form where the cashier picks which card reader takes this part of the payment.

card_reader.state.busy.explanation: State of a card reader that is in use by another payment.

card_reader.state.needs_setup.explanation: State of a card reader that is not set up yet.

card_reader.state.offline.explanation: State of a card reader the till cannot reach.

card_reader.state.ready.explanation: State of a card reader that can take a payment now.

card_reader.state.unchecked.explanation: State of a card reader whose readiness has not been checked yet.

card_reader.state.unknown.explanation: State of a card reader whose readiness could not be checked; it can still be tried.

notices.critical.ack.explanation: Button on a critical notice that a manager or admin presses to say they have seen it; it removes the strip.

notices.critical.cashier.explanation: Second line of the critical strip for a cashier, who cannot acknowledge it: a manager has been told and selling continues.

notices.dismiss.explanation: Button that hides a notice from the Unread tab; it stays in All until it expires.

notices.dismiss.aria.explanation:
Accessible name of the close button on a pop-up notice, naming the notice.

Placeholders:
- %s: the notice title

notices.drawer.open_unread.explanation:
Accessible name of the phone top bar menu button while notices are unread: the menu label plus how many are unread.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many notices are unread

notices.empty.body.explanation: Sentence under the empty-inbox heading: says what appears here and that selling is not affected.

notices.empty.title.explanation: Heading of the empty Notices inbox.

notices.expires.explanation:
Expiry line of a notice in the inbox; the date follows in the shop's date format.

Placeholders:
- %s: the date the notice stops showing

notices.nav.explanation: Label of the bell in the left rail (and the Notices row of the phone menu) that opens the Notices inbox.

notices.nav.unread.explanation:
Accessible name of the bell when something is unread: the label plus how many notices are unread.

Placeholders:
- %d: how many notices are unread

notices.open.explanation: Button or link that opens a notice in full, or follows the action link it carries.

notices.sender.partner.explanation:
Sender line on a notice sent by a partner of the shop; the partner name comes from the server.

Placeholders:
- %s: the partner's name

notices.sender.platform.explanation: Sender shown on a notice sent by Universal Till itself. A brand name: never translate it.

notices.sender.sr.explanation: Screen-reader-only word placed before the sender of a notice.

notices.sev.critical.explanation: Severity word on a notice from Universal Till that stays as a strip on every screen until a manager acknowledges it.

notices.sev.important.explanation: Severity word on a notice that also pops up once on the sale screen.

notices.sev.info.explanation: Severity word on a notice: plain information, shown in the inbox only.

notices.tab.all.explanation: Inbox tab showing every notice currently held, read or not.

notices.tab.unread.explanation: Inbox tab showing only notices not yet opened or dismissed.

notices.title.explanation: Heading of the Notices inbox page, listing messages from Universal Till and from partners.

notices.unread.sr.explanation: Screen-reader-only word placed before the title of an unread notice.

pos.error.void_voucher_additional_till.explanation: Error when a manager voids a sale on an additional till and the sale sold or topped up a gift voucher. The void is refused and nothing changes.

pos.scan_choice.customer.explanation: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a customer or loyalty card. The customer's name is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.item.explanation: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a catalog item (product). The item's name and price are shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.promo.explanation: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a promotion or discount code. The code is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.receipt.explanation: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is the number of an earlier receipt (sale), which opens its refund. The receipt number is shown under it.

pos.scan_choice.title.explanation: Heading of the sale-screen chooser shown when one scanned or typed code matches more than one thing (e.g. an item and a gift voucher). It asks the cashier which one they meant.

pos.scan_choice.voucher.explanation: Row label in the scan chooser: the code is a gift voucher number. The voucher number and remaining balance are shown under it.

pos.toast.line_discount_too_large.explanation:
Sale screen error toast: the sale was not completed because one basket line still has a discount larger than its line total. Nothing was charged; the cashier lowers that line's discount.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the item on that basket line

pos.toast.payment_outcome_unknown.explanation: Error toast on the till when a card payment may have been charged but the reader could not confirm it: tells the cashier to tap Pay again to settle it and not to take another payment.

pos.toast.tender_abandoned_check_provide.explanation: Error toast on the till after the cashier cleared, parked or switched away from a sale with an unconfirmed card payment, when a payment could not be sent back automatically or its outcome is unknown: tells the cashier to check with the payment provider and refund there.

pos.toast.tender_abandoned_returned_unkn.explanation: Error toast on the till after the cashier cleared, parked or switched away from a sale whose card payment was still unconfirmed: payments already taken were sent back automatically, but one card payment's outcome is unknown and must be checked with the provider.

tap.reader.pick.explanation: Heading of the panel where the cashier picks which card reader takes this payment, shown on the sale screen when the till has several readers.

tap.reason.reader_busy.explanation: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen right now because another payment is running on it.

tap.reason.reader_needs_setup.explanation: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen because it is not set up yet; staff are told to ask a manager.

tap.reason.reader_unreachable.explanation: One line under a card reader that cannot be chosen because the till cannot reach it (switched off, offline, out of range).

tender.card_reader.explanation: Label of the sale screen payment button that opens the list of card readers, used only when the generic Card button is also shown, so the two read differently.

tile_sheet.delete_item.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

tile_sheet.delete_item_confirm.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).
